subproblem.title: Rescaled local retractions onto N are C¹ retractions onto the blown-up set with Lipschitz constants tending to 1
subproblem.statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, U, N ⊆ ℝ^P with U open, x ∈ U ∩ N, δ > 0 and π : ℝ^P → ℝ^P such that (i) π is C¹ on B_δ(x) = ball x δ; (ii) π(B_δ(x)) ⊆ N; (iii) π(y) = y for every y ∈ N ∩ B_δ(x); (iv) for every η > 0 there is s with 0 < s ≤ δ and |π(y) − π(z)| ≤ (1 + η)|y − z| for all y, z ∈ B_s(x). Let λ_j > 0 (j ∈ ℕ) with λ_j → 0 and η_j := dilation x λ_j (η_j(y) = λ_j⁻¹(y − x)). Then for every G > 0 there are maps π_j : ℝ^P → ℝ^P (j ∈ ℕ) such that, for all large j, π_j is C¹ on B_G(0), maps B_G(0) into η_j(U ∩ N), satisfies π_j(y) = y for y ∈ η_j(U ∩ N) ∩ B_G(0), and |π_j(y)| ≤ 2|y| for y ∈ B_G(0); and such that for every η > 0, for all large j, |π_j(y) − π_j(z)| ≤ (1 + η)|y − z| for all y, z ∈ B_G(0). ('For all large j' means eventually in atTop; (i)–(iv) are the conclusion of local_retraction.)
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (δ : ℝ) (π : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen U → x ∈ U → x ∈ N → 0 < δ → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 π (ball x δ) → MapsTo π (ball x δ) N → (∀ y ∈ N ∩ ball x δ, π y = y) → (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s ≤ δ ∧ ∀ y ∈ ball x s, ∀ z ∈ ball x s, ‖π y - π z‖ ≤ (1 + η) * ‖y - z‖) → ∀ lams : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 < lams j) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∀ G : ℝ, 0 < G → ∃ πs : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid P, (∀ᶠ j in atTop, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (πs j) (ball 0 G) ∧ MapsTo (πs j) (ball 0 G) (dilation x (lams j) '' (U ∩ N)) ∧ (∀ y ∈ dilation x (lams j) '' (U ∩ N) ∩ ball 0 G, πs j y = y) ∧ ∀ y ∈ ball 0 G, ‖πs j y‖ ≤ 2 * ‖y‖) ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ y ∈ ball 0 G, ∀ z ∈ ball 0 G, ‖πs j y - πs j z‖ ≤ (1 + η) * ‖y - z‖
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 8 of the parent proof (the retractions onto N used in Simon's proof of the compactness theorem 7.2.4 and Remark 7.2.5(2), rescaled for the blow-ups of 7.3.1, chapter-07.txt lines 333–337). No dependencies: the retraction π and its properties (i)–(iv) are hypotheses here. They are exactly the conclusion of local_retraction, which the selected parent applies to N and x before invoking this lemma.
Notation: λ_j := lams j > 0, η_j := dilation x λ_j, so η_j(y) = −λ_j⁻¹x + λ_j⁻¹y = λ_j⁻¹(y − x). For every z, η_j(x + λ_jz) = z, and η_j(y') = z implies y' = x + λ_jz. Define, for every j ∈ ℕ,
 π_j(z) := η_j(π(x + λ_jz)) = λ_j⁻¹(π(x + λ_jz) − x)
(in Lean: πs := fun j z => dilation x (lams j) (π (x + lams j • z))). 'For all large j' means eventually in atTop.
1. (Radii.) Since U is open and x ∈ U, there is r₀ > 0 with B_{r₀}(x) ⊆ U. By (iv) with η = 1 there is s₁ with 0 < s₁ ≤ δ and |π(y) − π(z)| ≤ 2|y − z| for all y, z ∈ B_{s₁}(x). Since x ∈ N ∩ B_δ(x) (δ > 0), (iii) gives π(x) = x.
2. (Scaled points.) If λ > 0, t ∈ ℝ, λG ≤ t and |z| < G, then x + λz ∈ B_t(x), because |(x + λz) − x| = λ|z| < λG ≤ t.
3. (Large j.) For every t > 0, λ_jG → 0·G = 0, so λ_jG < t for all large j.
4. (The four properties.) Let j satisfy λ_jG < min(s₁, r₀/2) (all large j by step 3). Then λ_jG ≤ s₁ ≤ δ and λ_jG ≤ r₀/2. By step 2, the affine map a_j(z) := x + λ_jz maps B_G(0) into B_{s₁}(x) ⊆ B_δ(x).
 (a) (Key estimate.) Let z ∈ B_G(0) and y := x + λ_jz ∈ B_{s₁}(x). By step 1, |π(y) − x| = |π(y) − π(x)| ≤ 2|y − x| = 2λ_j|z|. Hence |π(y) − x| < 2λ_jG ≤ r₀, so π(y) ∈ B_{r₀}(x) ⊆ U; and π(y) ∈ N by (ii), since y ∈ B_δ(x). Thus π(y) ∈ U ∩ N.
 (b) (C¹.) a_j is affine, hence C^∞, and maps B_G(0) into B_δ(x), where π is C¹ by (i); so π∘a_j is C¹ on B_G(0) (ContDiffOn.comp). η_j is a constant plus the continuous linear map λ_j⁻¹·id, hence C^∞, so π_j = η_j∘(π∘a_j) is C¹ on B_G(0) (ContDiff.comp_contDiffOn).
 (c) (Maps into η_j(U ∩ N).) For z ∈ B_G(0), π_j(z) = η_j(π(x + λ_jz)) with π(x + λ_jz) ∈ U ∩ N by (a); so π_j(z) ∈ η_j(U ∩ N).
 (d) (Identity.) Let z ∈ η_j(U ∩ N) ∩ B_G(0), say z = η_j(y') with y' ∈ U ∩ N. Then x + λ_jz = x + λ_jλ_j⁻¹(y' − x) = y', and y' = a_j(z) ∈ B_δ(x) because z ∈ B_G(0). As y' ∈ N ∩ B_δ(x), (iii) gives π(y') = y'. Hence π_j(z) = η_j(π(y')) = η_j(y') = z.
 (e) (Growth.) For z ∈ B_G(0), |π_j(z)| = |λ_j⁻¹(π(x + λ_jz) − x)| = λ_j⁻¹|π(x + λ_jz) − x| ≤ λ_j⁻¹·2λ_j|z| = 2|z| by (a).
 Thus, for all large j, π_j is C¹ on B_G(0), maps B_G(0) into η_j(U ∩ N), is the identity on η_j(U ∩ N) ∩ B_G(0), and satisfies |π_j(z)| ≤ 2|z| on B_G(0).
5. (Almost isometry.) Let η > 0. By (iv) there is s with 0 < s ≤ δ and |π(y) − π(z)| ≤ (1 + η)|y − z| for y, z ∈ B_s(x). By step 3, λ_jG < s for all large j; fix such j and y, z ∈ B_G(0). By step 2, x + λ_jy and x + λ_jz lie in B_s(x). Since
 π_j(y) − π_j(z) = λ_j⁻¹(π(x + λ_jy) − x) − λ_j⁻¹(π(x + λ_jz) − x) = λ_j⁻¹(π(x + λ_jy) − π(x + λ_jz))
 and |(x + λ_jy) − (x + λ_jz)| = λ_j|y − z|, we get |π_j(y) − π_j(z)| ≤ λ_j⁻¹(1 + η)λ_j|y − z| = (1 + η)|y − z|.
6. (Conclusion.) The family (π_j)_j does not depend on η; step 4 proves the first (eventual) conjunct and step 5 the second, for every G > 0. ∎

theorem Submission.dtc_bc_bh_rescaled_retraction : ∀ (P : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (δ : ℝ) (π : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen U → x ∈ U → x ∈ N → 0 < δ → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 π (ball x δ) → MapsTo π (ball x δ) N → (∀ y ∈ N ∩ ball x δ, π y = y) → (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s ≤ δ ∧ ∀ y ∈ ball x s, ∀ z ∈ ball x s, ‖π y - π z‖ ≤ (1 + η) * ‖y - z‖) → ∀ lams : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 < lams j) → Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∀ G : ℝ, 0 < G → ∃ πs : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid P, (∀ᶠ j in atTop, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (πs j) (ball 0 G) ∧ MapsTo (πs j) (ball 0 G) (dilation x (lams j) '' (U ∩ N)) ∧ (∀ y ∈ dilation x (lams j) '' (U ∩ N) ∩ ball 0 G, πs j y = y) ∧ ∀ y ∈ ball 0 G, ‖πs j y‖ ≤ 2 * ‖y‖) ∧ ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ y ∈ ball 0 G, ∀ z ∈ ball 0 G, ‖πs j y - πs j z‖ ≤ (1 + η) * ‖y - z‖ := by
  intro P U N x δ π hU hxU hxN hδ hC hmaps hid hlip lams hlams hlim G hG
  -- a ball `B_{r₀}(x) ⊆ U`
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, hr₀U⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hU x hxU
  -- `π` is `2`-Lipschitz on `B_{s₁}(x)`
  obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁, hs₁δ, hlip1⟩ := hlip 1 one_pos
  have hπx : π x = x := hid x ⟨hxN, mem_ball_self hδ⟩
  -- `η_{x,λ}(y) = λ⁻¹ • (y - x)`
  have hdil : ∀ (lam : ℝ) (y : Euclid P), dilation x lam y = lam⁻¹ • (y - x) := by
    intro lam y
    simp only [dilation, dilationCLM, FunLike.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_id', id_eq, smul_sub]
    abel
  -- `x + λ • z ∈ B_t(x)` when `z ∈ B_G(0)` and `λ G ≤ t`
  have hmem : ∀ (lam t : ℝ) (z : Euclid P), 0 < lam → lam * G ≤ t → z ∈ ball (0 : Euclid P) G →
      x + lam • z ∈ ball x t := by
    intro lam t z hlam hlt hz
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hlam.le]
    rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hz
    calc lam * ‖z‖ < lam * G := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz hlam
      _ ≤ t := hlt
  have hsmall : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ᶠ j in atTop, lams j * G < t := by
    intro t ht
    have h0 : Tendsto (fun j => lams j * G) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using hlim.mul_const G
    exact (tendsto_order.1 h0).2 t ht
  refine ⟨fun j z => dilation x (lams j) (π (x + lams j • z)), ?_, ?_⟩
  · filter_upwards [hsmall (min s₁ (r₀ / 2)) (lt_min hs₁ (half_pos hr₀))] with j hj
    have hlam := hlams j
    have hj₁ : lams j * G ≤ s₁ := hj.le.trans (min_le_left _ _)
    have hj₂ : lams j * G ≤ r₀ / 2 := hj.le.trans (min_le_right _ _)
    have hjδ : lams j * G ≤ δ := hj₁.trans hs₁δ
    -- the affine map `z ↦ x + λⱼ z` maps `B_G(0)` into `B_δ(x)`
    have hmapsδ : MapsTo (fun z : Euclid P => x + lams j • z) (ball 0 G) (ball x δ) :=
      fun z hz => hmem (lams j) δ z hlam hjδ hz
    -- `π(x + λⱼ z) ∈ U ∩ N` and `|π(x + λⱼ z) - x| ≤ 2 λⱼ |z|`
    have hkey : ∀ z ∈ ball (0 : Euclid P) G, π (x + lams j • z) ∈ U ∩ N ∧
        ‖π (x + lams j • z) - x‖ ≤ 2 * (lams j * ‖z‖) := by
      intro z hz
      have hy : x + lams j • z ∈ ball x s₁ := hmem (lams j) s₁ z hlam hj₁ hz
      have hbd : ‖π (x + lams j • z) - x‖ ≤ 2 * (lams j * ‖z‖) := by
        have := hlip1 _ hy x (mem_ball_self hs₁)
        rw [hπx] at this
        calc ‖π (x + lams j • z) - x‖ ≤ (1 + 1) * ‖x + lams j • z - x‖ := this
          _ = 2 * (lams j * ‖z‖) := by
            rw [add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hlam.le]; norm_num
      refine ⟨⟨hr₀U ?_, hmaps (hmapsδ hz)⟩, hbd⟩
      rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
      rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hz
      calc ‖π (x + lams j • z) - x‖ ≤ 2 * (lams j * ‖z‖) := hbd
        _ < 2 * (lams j * G) := by
          have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hz hlam
          linarith
        _ ≤ r₀ := by linarith
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · -- `C¹` on `B_G(0)`
      have hdilC : ContDiff ℝ 1 (dilation x (lams j)) := by
        unfold dilation
        exact contDiff_const.add (dilationCLM P (lams j)).contDiff
      have haff : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun z : Euclid P => x + lams j • z) :=
        contDiff_const.add (contDiff_id.const_smul (lams j))
      exact hdilC.comp_contDiffOn (hC.comp haff.contDiffOn hmapsδ)
    · -- maps `B_G(0)` into `η_j(U ∩ N)`
      intro z hz
      exact ⟨π (x + lams j • z), (hkey z hz).1, rfl⟩
    · -- identity on `η_j(U ∩ N) ∩ B_G(0)`
      rintro z ⟨⟨y', hy', rfl⟩, hz⟩
      have hinv : x + lams j • dilation x (lams j) y' = y' := by
        rw [hdil, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hlam.ne', one_smul, add_sub_cancel]
      show dilation x (lams j) (π (x + lams j • dilation x (lams j) y')) = dilation x (lams j) y'
      rw [hinv, hid y' ⟨hy'.2, ?_⟩]
      rw [← hinv]
      exact hmapsδ hz
    · -- `|π_j(z)| ≤ 2|z|`
      intro z hz
      show ‖dilation x (lams j) (π (x + lams j • z))‖ ≤ 2 * ‖z‖
      rw [hdil, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hlam.le)]
      calc (lams j)⁻¹ * ‖π (x + lams j • z) - x‖ ≤ (lams j)⁻¹ * (2 * (lams j * ‖z‖)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hkey z hz).2 (inv_nonneg.2 hlam.le)
        _ = 2 * ‖z‖ := by field_simp
  · intro η hη
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsδ, hlipη⟩ := hlip η hη
    filter_upwards [hsmall s hs] with j hj y hy z hz
    have hlam := hlams j
    have hy' := hmem (lams j) s y hlam hj.le hy
    have hz' := hmem (lams j) s z hlam hj.le hz
    show ‖dilation x (lams j) (π (x + lams j • y)) - dilation x (lams j) (π (x + lams j • z))‖ ≤
      (1 + η) * ‖y - z‖
    rw [hdil, hdil, ← smul_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hlam.le)]
    have h1 := hlipη _ hy' _ hz'
    have h2 : ‖x + lams j • y - (x + lams j • z)‖ = lams j * ‖y - z‖ := by
      rw [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, ← smul_sub, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hlam.le]
    have h3 : π (x + lams j • y) - x - (π (x + lams j • z) - x) =
        π (x + lams j • y) - π (x + lams j • z) := by abel
    rw [h3]
    calc (lams j)⁻¹ * ‖π (x + lams j • y) - π (x + lams j • z)‖
        ≤ (lams j)⁻¹ * ((1 + η) * (lams j * ‖y - z‖)) := by
          rw [← h2]; exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (inv_nonneg.2 hlam.le)
      _ = (1 + η) * ‖y - z‖ := by field_simp
proof_key_steps: Choose r₀ > 0 with B_{r₀}(x) ⊆ U and s₁ ∈ (0, δ] with π 2-Lipschitz on B_{s₁}(x); π(x) = x by (iii).
Define π_j(z) := η_j(π(x + λ_jz)); once λ_jG < min(s₁, r₀/2), x + λ_jz ∈ B_{s₁}(x) ⊆ B_δ(x) for z ∈ B_G(0).
Then π(x + λ_jz) ∈ U ∩ N with |π(x + λ_jz) − x| ≤ 2λ_j|z|, which gives C¹ (chain rule), MapsTo into η_j(U ∩ N), the identity on η_j(U ∩ N) ∩ B_G(0) via (iii), and |π_j(z)| ≤ 2|z|.
For η > 0 and λ_jG < s(η), the (1+η)-Lipschitz bound of π on B_{s(η)}(x) rescales to |π_j(y) − π_j(z)| ≤ (1+η)|y − z|.

subproblem.title: Blow-up domains are open and exhaust ℝ^P, and blow-up boundaries vanish on growing balls
subproblem.statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U), and x ∈ U with x ∉ spt ∂T (x ∉ boundarySupport T, which in degree m + 1 is T.boundary.support). Let λ_j > 0 (j ∈ ℕ) with λ_j → 0, η_j := dilation x λ_j (η_j(y) = λ_j⁻¹(y − x)) and S_j := blowUp T x λ_j ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(η_j(U)). Then (1) η_j(U) is open for every j; (2) for every R ∈ ℝ, closedBall(0, R) ⊆ η_j(U) for all large j; (3) for every R ∈ ℝ, for all large j, ∂S_j(β) = 0 for every β ∈ 𝒟^m(η_j(U)) (TestFormOn (η_j(U)) m) with tsupport β ⊆ B_R(0) = ball 0 R. ('For all large j' means eventually in atTop.)

Source: steps 0, 1, 2, 3 and 7 of the parent proof (Simon 7.3.1, chapter-07.txt lines 334–335: '∂η_{x,λ_j#}T = 0 in B_R(0) for sufficiently large j (because x ∉ spt ∂T)'). Dependencies: the siblings vanish_off_support = accepted Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support (V: for any current Y in any domain V and any test form ω in V, if tsupport ω is disjoint from spt Y then Y(ω) = 0) and blowup_algebra = accepted Submission.dtc_blowUp_algebra (ALG; used for λ > 0: (iii) spt(η_{x,λ#}Y) = η_{x,λ}(spt Y) for every k and Y ∈ 𝒟_k(U); (iv) ∂(η_{x,λ#}T) = η_{x,λ#}(∂T) for T ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(U)). ALG (iii)–(iv) package exactly the unfolding of step 0 of the parent proof (S_j(ω) = T(η_j^#ω), ∂S_j(β) = ∂T(η_j^#β), tsupport η_j^#β ⊆ η_j⁻¹(tsupport β)).
Notation: λ_j := lams j > 0, η_j := dilation x λ_j, so η_j(y) = −λ_j⁻¹x + λ_j⁻¹y = λ_j⁻¹(y − x); S_j := blowUp T x λ_j ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(η_j(U)); η_{j#}Y := blowUp Y x λ_j. For a current Y in a domain V, Z(Y) := zeroRegion Y (the union of the open W with compact closure W ⊆ V on which Y vanishes) is open (GeometricCurrentOn.isOpen_zeroRegion) and spt Y = V ∖ Z(Y). In degree m + 1, boundarySupport T = spt ∂T = T.boundary.support. 'For all large j' means eventually in atTop.
0. (The dilation.) For λ > 0, η := dilation x λ is the translation y ↦ y − x followed by the scaling v ↦ λ⁻¹v (λ⁻¹ ≠ 0); both are homeomorphisms of ℝ^P (Homeomorph.subRight, Homeomorph.smulOfNeZero), so η is a homeomorphism and in particular an open map. Moreover η(x + λz) = λ⁻¹(λz) = z for every z, and η(y) = z implies y = x + λ·λ⁻¹(y − x) = x + λz.
1. ((1)) η_j(U) is the image of the open set U under the homeomorphism η_j (step 0), hence open, for every j.
2. (A good radius.) Since x ∈ U and x ∉ spt ∂T = U ∖ Z(∂T), we have x ∈ Z(∂T). The set U ∩ Z(∂T) is open and contains x, so there is r > 0 with B_r(x) ⊆ U ∩ Z(∂T). (The parent chose closedBall(x, 2r) ⊆ U ∩ Z(∂T); the open ball B_r(x) plays the same role here.)
3. (Large j.) For every R ∈ ℝ, λ_jR → 0·R = 0, hence λ_jR < r for all large j (for R ≤ 0 this holds for every j).
4. ((2)) Let R ∈ ℝ, let j satisfy λ_jR < r (step 3) and let z ∈ closedBall(0, R), i.e. |z| ≤ R. Put y := x + λ_jz. Then |y − x| = λ_j|z| ≤ λ_jR < r, so y ∈ B_r(x) ⊆ U, and η_j(y) = z by step 0. Hence z ∈ η_j(U). Thus closedBall(0, R) ⊆ η_j(U) for all large j (for R < 0 the ball is empty).
5. ((3)) Let R ∈ ℝ, let j satisfy λ_jR < r (step 3), and let β ∈ 𝒟^m(η_j(U)) with tsupport β ⊆ B_R(0).
 (a) By ALG(iv) (λ_j > 0), ∂S_j = η_{j#}(∂T) as currents in 𝒟_m(η_j(U)); hence ∂S_j(β) = η_{j#}(∂T)(β).
 (b) By ALG(iii) applied to the m-current ∂T ∈ 𝒟_m(U), spt η_{j#}(∂T) = η_j(spt ∂T).
 (c) tsupport β ∩ η_j(spt ∂T) = ∅. Indeed, suppose z ∈ tsupport β and z = η_j(y) with y ∈ spt ∂T. By step 0, y = x + λ_jz. As z ∈ B_R(0), |z| < R, so |y − x| = λ_j|z| ≤ λ_jR < r and y ∈ B_r(x) ⊆ Z(∂T) by step 2. This contradicts y ∈ spt ∂T = U ∖ Z(∂T).
 (d) By (b) and (c), tsupport β is disjoint from spt η_{j#}(∂T). V, applied to the current η_{j#}(∂T) in the domain η_j(U) and the test form β, gives η_{j#}(∂T)(β) = 0; by (a), ∂S_j(β) = 0.
 (This is step 7 of the parent proof transported by η_j: there ∂S_j(β) = ∂T(η_j^#β), tsupport(η_j^#β) ⊆ η_j⁻¹(B_R(0)) = B_{λ_jR}(x) ⊆ Z(∂T), and V is applied to ∂T.)
6. (Conclusion.) Step 1 proves (1); steps 3–4 prove (2); steps 3 and 5 prove (3): for every R, for all j with λ_jR < r (all large j) and every β ∈ 𝒟^m(η_j(U)) with tsupport β ⊆ B_R(0), ∂S_j(β) = 0. ∎

theorem Submission.dtc_bc_bh_blowUp_domain_boundary : ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)) (x : Euclid P), IsOpen U → x ∈ U → x ∉ boundarySupport T → ∀ (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → (∀ j, IsOpen (dilation x (lams j) '' U)) ∧ (∀ R : ℝ, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R ⊆ dilation x (lams j) '' U) ∧ (∀ R : ℝ, ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ ω : TestFormOn (dilation x (lams j) '' U) m, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) ⊆ ball 0 R → (blowUp T x (lams j) (hlams j).ne').boundary ω = 0) := by
  intro P m U T x hU hxU hxb lams hlams hlim
  -- `η_{x,λ}(y) = λ⁻¹ • (y - x)`
  have hdil : ∀ (lam : ℝ) (y : Euclid P), dilation x lam y = lam⁻¹ • (y - x) := by
    intro lam y
    simp only [dilation, dilationCLM, FunLike.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.coe_id', id_eq, smul_sub]
    abel
  -- `η_{x,λ}(x + λ z) = z` and `η_{x,λ}(y) = z → y = x + λ z`
  have hdil_inv : ∀ (lam : ℝ) (z : Euclid P), lam ≠ 0 → dilation x lam (x + lam • z) = z := by
    intro lam z hlam
    rw [hdil, add_sub_cancel_left, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hlam, one_smul]
  have hdil_eq : ∀ (lam : ℝ) (y z : Euclid P), lam ≠ 0 → dilation x lam y = z → y = x + lam • z := by
    intro lam y z hlam h
    rw [← h, hdil, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hlam, one_smul, add_sub_cancel]
  -- `λⱼ R` is eventually below any positive bound
  have hsmall : ∀ (R t : ℝ), 0 < t → ∀ᶠ j in atTop, lams j * R < t := by
    intro R t ht
    have h0 : Tendsto (fun j => lams j * R) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
      simpa using hlim.mul_const R
    exact (tendsto_order.1 h0).2 t ht
  -- (1) the blown-up domains are open
  have hopen : ∀ j, IsOpen (dilation x (lams j) '' U) := by
    intro j
    have hlam : lams j ≠ 0 := (hlams j).ne'
    have hfun : dilation x (lams j) =
        ((Homeomorph.subRight x).trans (Homeomorph.smulOfNeZero (lams j)⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero hlam)) :
          Euclid P → Euclid P) := by
      funext y
      rw [hdil]
      rfl
    rw [hfun]
    exact ((Homeomorph.subRight x).trans
      (Homeomorph.smulOfNeZero (lams j)⁻¹ (inv_ne_zero hlam))).isOpenMap U hU
  -- a ball `B_r(x)` inside `U` and inside the zero region of `∂T`
  have hxZ : x ∈ T.boundary.zeroRegion := by
    by_contra h
    exact hxb ⟨hxU, h⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrU⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 (hU.inter T.boundary.isOpen_zeroRegion) x ⟨hxU, hxZ⟩
  refine ⟨hopen, ?_, ?_⟩
  · -- (2) `closedBall 0 R ⊆ η_j(U)` once `λⱼ R < r`
    intro R
    filter_upwards [hsmall R r hr] with j hj
    intro z hz
    have hlam := hlams j
    refine ⟨x + lams j • z, (hrU ?_).1, hdil_inv (lams j) z hlam.ne'⟩
    rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hlam.le]
    rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hz
    calc lams j * ‖z‖ ≤ lams j * R := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz hlam.le
      _ < r := hj
  · -- (6) `∂S_j(β) = 0` for `spt β ⊆ B_R(0)` once `λⱼ R < r`
    intro R
    filter_upwards [hsmall R r hr] with j hj ω hω
    have hlam := hlams j
    have hALG := Submission.dtc_blowUp_algebra P U x (lams j) hlam
    rw [hALG.2.2.2 m T]
    apply Submission.dtc_vanish_off_support
    rw [hALG.2.2.1 m T.boundary, Set.disjoint_left]
    rintro z hz ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩
    have hyx : y = x + lams j • z := hdil_eq (lams j) y z hlam.ne' hyz
    have hzR := hω hz
    rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hzR
    have hyball : y ∈ ball x r := by
      rw [hyx, mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg hlam.le]
      calc lams j * ‖z‖ ≤ lams j * R := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hzR.le hlam.le
        _ < r := hj
    exact hy.2 (hrU hyball).2
proof_key_steps: η_j is a homeomorphism with η_j(x + λ_jz) = z, so η_j(U) is open and η_j(y) = z forces y = x + λ_jz.
x ∈ U ∩ zeroRegion(∂T) gives r > 0 with B_r(x) ⊆ U ∩ zeroRegion(∂T); λ_jR < r for all large j.
closedBall(0, R) ⊆ η_j(B_r(x)) ⊆ η_j(U) once λ_jR < r.
∂S_j = η_{j#}∂T and spt η_{j#}∂T = η_j(spt ∂T) (ALG); tsupport β ⊆ B_R(0) misses η_j(spt ∂T) once λ_jR < r, so ∂S_j(β) = 0 by V.

subproblem.title: Blow-ups at a point of finite density have locally bounded mass
subproblem.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, let U ⊆ ℝ^P (Euclid P) be open, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), x ∈ ℝ^P and θ ∈ ℝ with HasMassDensity T x θ, i.e. θ ≥ 0 and M_{B_ρ(x)}(T)/(ω_n·ofReal(ρⁿ)) → ofReal θ in [0, ∞] as ρ → 0⁺, where ω_n = unitBallVolume n is the Lebesgue measure of the unit ball of ℝⁿ and M_W = massOn. Let λ_j > 0 (j ∈ ℕ) with λ_j → 0, and S_j := η_{x,λ_j#}T = blowUp T x λ_j ∈ 𝒟_n(η_{x,λ_j}(U)). Then for every R ∈ ℝ there is c ∈ [0, ∞) (c ≠ ∞) such that M_{B_R(0)}(S_j) = S_j.massOn (ball 0 R) ≤ c for all large j (eventually in atTop).
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (x : Euclid P) (θ : ℝ), IsOpen U → 0 < n → HasMassDensity T x θ → ∀ (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (hlams : ∀ j, 0 < lams j), Tendsto lams atTop (𝓝 0) → ∀ R : ℝ, ∃ c : ℝ≥0∞, c ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ᶠ j in atTop, (blowUp T x (lams j) (hlams j).ne').massOn (ball 0 R) ≤ c
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 6 of the parent proof (Simon 7.3.1, proof display (1), chapter-07.txt lines 329–335: (ω_nRⁿ)⁻¹M_{B_R(0)}(η_{x,λ_j#}T) = (ω_nλ_jⁿRⁿ)⁻¹M_{B_{λ_jR}(x)}(T) → Θⁿ(μ_T, x) 'for each R > 0, and hence sup_j M_{B_R(0)}(η_{x,λ_j#}T) < ∞'). Dependency: the sibling blowup_scaling, i.e. the accepted declaration Submission.dtc_blowUp_scaling (BU). Only its part (1) is used: for U open, n > 0 and λ > 0, M_{η_{x,λ}(W)}(η_{x,λ#}T) = ofReal(λ⁻¹ⁿ)·M_W(T) for every W ⊆ ℝ^P.
Notation: λ_j := lams j > 0, η_j := dilation x λ_j, so η_j(y) = −λ_j⁻¹x + λ_j⁻¹y = λ_j⁻¹(y − x); S_j := blowUp T x λ_j ∈ 𝒟_n(η_j(U)). For a current Y in a domain V and W ⊆ ℝ^P, M_W(Y) = Y.massOn W is the supremum in [0, ∞] of ofReal(Y(ω)) over the admissible forms ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(V) with tsupport ω ⊆ W and Euclidean coefficient norm at most 1 at every point (SimonGMT massOn, massAdmissibleOn). ω_n := unitBallVolume n = volume(ball(0, 1)) in ℝⁿ. 'For all large j' means 'for all j ≥ some j₀', i.e. eventually in atTop.
1. (Case R ≤ 0.) Then B_R(0) = ball 0 R = ∅. Let ω be admissible for M_∅(S_j). If ω(y) ≠ 0 for some y, then y ∈ support ω ⊆ tsupport ω ⊆ ∅, which is impossible; so ω = 0 and S_j(ω) = S_j(0) = 0 by linearity. Hence every element of the set whose supremum defines M_∅(S_j) equals ofReal 0 = 0, so M_{B_R(0)}(S_j) = 0 for every j. Take c := 0 (c ≠ ∞). This proves the claim for R ≤ 0; from now on R > 0.
2. (The constant ω_n.) 0 < ω_n < ∞: the unit ball of ℝⁿ is a nonempty open set and Lebesgue measure charges nonempty open sets (Metric.measure_ball_pos), and balls in the proper space ℝⁿ have finite Lebesgue measure (measure_ball_lt_top). Write F(ρ) := T.massOn(B_ρ(x)) / (ω_n·ofReal(ρⁿ)).
3. (A density bound near 0.) HasMassDensity T x θ says θ ≥ 0 and F(ρ) → ofReal θ in [0, ∞] as ρ → 0⁺ (along 𝓝[>] 0). Since θ < θ + 1 and θ + 1 > 0, ofReal θ < ofReal(θ + 1) (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff). By the order-topology characterization of the limit, F(ρ) < ofReal(θ + 1) eventually along 𝓝[>] 0; as the intervals (0, u), u > 0, form a basis of 𝓝[>] 0 (nhdsGT_basis), there is s₀ > 0 with F(ρ) < ofReal(θ + 1) for every ρ ∈ (0, s₀).
4. (Mass bound for T.) Let ρ ∈ (0, s₀) and b(ρ) := ω_n·ofReal(ρⁿ). Then b(ρ) ≠ 0 (ω_n ≠ 0 and ρⁿ > 0) and b(ρ) ≠ ∞ (ω_n ≠ ∞). For such b, a / b < c ⟺ a < c·b in [0, ∞] (ENNReal.div_lt_iff), so step 3 gives T.massOn(B_ρ(x)) < ofReal(θ + 1)·(ω_n·ofReal(ρⁿ)); in particular T.massOn(B_ρ(x)) ≤ ofReal(θ + 1)·(ω_n·ofReal(ρⁿ)).
5. (The constant c.) Put c := ofReal(θ + 1)·(ω_n·ofReal(Rⁿ)). It is finite, being a product of finite factors (ω_n ≠ ∞ by step 2).
6. (Large j.) Since λ_j → 0, also λ_jR → 0·R = 0, so λ_jR < s₀ for all large j. Fix such a j and write λ := λ_j > 0; then 0 < λR < s₀ (R > 0).
7. (Image of the ball.) η_j(B_{λR}(x)) = B_R(0). If |y − x| < λR then |η_j(y)| = |λ⁻¹(y − x)| = λ⁻¹|y − x| < λ⁻¹λR = R. Conversely, if |z| < R then y := x + λz satisfies |y − x| = λ|z| < λR and η_j(y) = λ⁻¹(x + λz − x) = z.
8. (Scaling.) By step 7 and BU(1) with W := B_{λR}(x) (U open, n > 0, λ > 0):
 S_j.massOn(B_R(0)) = S_j.massOn(η_j(B_{λR}(x))) = ofReal(λ⁻¹ⁿ)·T.massOn(B_{λR}(x)).
 By step 4 with ρ := λR ∈ (0, s₀) and monotonicity of multiplication in [0, ∞],
 S_j.massOn(B_R(0)) ≤ ofReal(λ⁻¹ⁿ)·(ofReal(θ + 1)·(ω_n·ofReal((λR)ⁿ))) = ofReal(θ + 1)·(ω_n·(ofReal(λ⁻¹ⁿ)·ofReal((λR)ⁿ))) = ofReal(θ + 1)·(ω_n·ofReal(λ⁻¹ⁿ·(λR)ⁿ)) = ofReal(θ + 1)·(ω_n·ofReal(Rⁿ)) = c,
 using commutativity and associativity in [0, ∞], ofReal(a)·ofReal(b) = ofReal(ab) for a = λ⁻¹ⁿ ≥ 0 (ENNReal.ofReal_mul), and λ⁻¹ⁿ(λR)ⁿ = (λ⁻¹λ)ⁿRⁿ = Rⁿ.
9. (Conclusion.) Steps 5–8 give c ≠ ∞ with S_j.massOn(B_R(0)) ≤ c for all large j when R > 0, and step 1 handles R ≤ 0. Hence for every R ∈ ℝ there is c ∈ [0, ∞) with M_{B_R(0)}(S_j) ≤ c for all large j. ∎
